::: {.project-hook}
Won **1st prize** at Google Code To Learn, India's national coding competition for school students, by building a functional Android application.
:::

## Overview

Google Code To Learn challenged students to create real software using visual programming. I designed and built an Android app that demonstrated both creative problem-solving and technical execution — earning national recognition at age 13.

## What I Did

::: {.project-section}
<ul class="star-list">
<li><strong>Situation:</strong> Google invited school students across India to build working applications using Scratch-based tools, competing for national recognition.</li>
<li><strong>Task:</strong> Design, develop, and present an original Android application that solved a meaningful problem.</li>
<li><strong>Action:</strong> Built a complete Android app from scratch, iterating on UX and functionality until the product was demo-ready.</li>
<li><strong>Result:</strong> Won **1st prize** nationally. The certificate is displayed on my [About page](/index-en.html#hero-heading).</li>
</ul>
:::
